author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand reacts to Zohran Mamdani's stance on socialism and capitalism and pushes back hard on the idea that a socialist model inspired by Dr Martin Luther King's vision is the answer to America's economic problems. While Russell acknowledges the appeal of challenging capitalist structures he argues that in practice Mamdani's approach amounts to one thing — more taxes for everyone. A sharp and entertaining clash of ideas about who really pays the price when governments decide to reshape the economy in the name of social justice.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand sits down with his wife Laura to explore the serenity prayer and why its full meaning goes so much deeper than most people ever realise. Russell and Laura reflect on how the first part of the prayer has become universally known and recited across cultures and backgrounds while the second deeply theological and Christ centred section remains largely unknown and unspoken. A warm and intimate conversation about faith, prayer and why the full serenity prayer may be one of the most powerful and complete expressions of Christian surrender ever written.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand reacts to a viral exchange between Donald Trump and Keir Starmer where Trump openly declares his disdain for the Mayor of London forcing an visibly uncomfortable Keir to awkwardly step in and defend his ally. Russell breaks down what the moment really reveals about the power dynamic at play — that when genuine power is in the room Keir Starmer's opinion barely registers as a consideration. A fascinating and deeply telling glimpse into how real geopolitical power operates and where the UK's Prime Minister actually sits in that hierarchy.
